summary: Open-source platform for tracing, evaluating and improving LLM apps and agents, with prompt management and dashboards.

heroCommands.command:
git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse.git
cd langfuse
docker compose up

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Langfuse is an open-source AI engineering platform. It records traces of LLM calls and agent actions so you can debug them, and adds prompt management, evaluations, an AI gateway, and dashboards for latency, cost and quality.
sixtySeconds.problem: LLM apps are hard to debug and improve because you can't see what happened inside a request. Langfuse shows each step and lets you measure changes.
whoFor: Developers building LLM apps and agents
Ops staff tracking AI cost and latency
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a popular, MIT-licensed observability platform you can self-host in minutes or use as a cloud service with a free tier.
requirements: Docker for self-hosting, or a Langfuse Cloud account
Python or JS SDK in your app

overview: Core features: observability (traces), prompt management with versioning, skill management (beta), evaluations (LLM-as-a-judge, code evaluators, user feedback), an AI gateway (beta), metrics dashboards and a full API.
Use Langfuse Cloud (free tier, no card needed) or self-host with Docker Compose, Kubernetes (Helm, recommended for production) or Terraform templates for AWS, Azure and GCP.

To start tracing, create a project and API keys, install the SDK, set LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_BASE_URL, and decorate functions with @observe(). The repo is MIT licensed except the ee folders.
